column1: Jarvis Topic Manager — Ports Protocols and Services Management (PPSM)

column6: Description
Secure shell administration (key-based; password auth disabled)
Redirect to HTTPS (301 permanent) — no content served
Topic Manager Web UI + REST API (nginx TLS termination, TLS 1.2/1.3 only)
nginx -> gunicorn, bound 127.0.0.1 only
Local stub resolver (127.0.0.53/127.0.0.54)
AD credential validation and group membership check. TLS certificate validation is ENFORCED (CERT_REQUIRED) from v1.0.2.
Kafka AdminClient wire protocol — broker1-3.int.crypticlight.com
Kafka AdminClient over SSL — only if a cluster is configured with security_protocol SSL/SASL_SSL. Not used in the current deployment.
Resolution of the domain controller and Kafka broker hostnames
Time synchronisation — required for TLS validity and audit timestamp accuracy

column1: --- OUTBOUND (INSTALL / UPGRADE TIME ONLY — not required at runtime) ---

column6: OS package installation and patching (apt). Not required on an air-gapped host.
Python wheel download for the pinned dependency set. Not required on an air-gapped host.
Vue.js runtime download. Verified against a pinned SHA-256 before use. Not required on an air-gapped host.
Source clone performed by install/upgrade-full.sh. Not required on an air-gapped host.
Software Composition Analysis gate (tools/sca-check.sh). Developer/CI workstation only — never invoked on the target host.
/opt/topic-manager/data/tm.db — audit log (user, action, target, timestamp, cluster) and application settings
sessions table in the same SQLite DB — session id, user, created/last-seen/expiry, source IP. The browser cookie carries only a signed session id, never user data.
Signed Flask cookie holding the session id only. HTTPOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax.
UI preferences only — no credentials or sensitive data
/etc/topic-manager/tls/server.key — 0640 root:topic-manager
/etc/topic-manager/config.yaml — 0640 root:topic-manager. Contains the Flask secret_key and, if a service account is configured, the LDAP bind password.
/var/backups/topic-manager/<timestamp>/ — 0700 root:root. Contains config, TLS key and audit DB; archives are 0600.
